title: The Wolverines at Doyle's Dancing Academy
summary: After the Stockton Club the Wolverines play a run-down ballroom at Doyle's, where Davison goes to listen.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: There was a lot of trouble and that's pretty much explained in Phil Evans' book.
About Bix -- that's when they went to Doyle's Dancing---

Yes, they went to Doyle's and I used to go up with Carl; we'd go up and listen to them at Doyle's Academy and I thought that was the funniest place for that lovely band to play; it was really a terrible, old broken down ballroom - a dirty one. You know, it was just an old broken down ballroom. And, those guys played up there and it was something to hear that band.
